nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' ('Nimbus Wrapped Ether'); constant metadata, never written after deployment.
Public string state variable 'symbol' ('NWETH'); constant metadata.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' fixed to 18; constant token metadata.
Mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf: canonical ETH credit ledger mutated by deposit, withdraw and transferFrom.
Mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance: spender approvals mutated by approve and transferFrom.
receive() payable external fallback that forwards plain ETH transfers to deposit().
deposit() public payable: credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with msg.value using SafeMath.add and emits Deposit.
withdraw(uint wad) public: verifies balance, debits balanceOf[msg.sender], then sends ETH with payable(msg.sender).transfer(wad) and emits Withdrawal.
totalSupply() public view: returns address(this).balance as the outstanding wrapped-ETH supply.
approve(address guy, uint wad) public: overwrites allowance[msg.sender][guy] with wad and emits Approval.
transfer(address dst, uint wad) public: thin wrapper delegating to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad) public: checks balance and allowance, debits src and credits dst via SafeMath, emits Transfer.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used as ledger key and as the ETH recipient of withdraw.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(wad) external ETH send inside withdraw: external interaction performed against a caller-chosen address.
Parameter 'wad' of withdraw(uint wad): caller-supplied amount of ETH to redeem.
Parameter 'guy' of approve(address guy, uint wad): spender address being approved.
Parameter 'wad' of approve(address guy, uint wad): approval amount written into allowance.
Parameter 'dst' of transfer(address dst, uint wad): recipient forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter 'wad' of transfer(address dst, uint wad): amount forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter 'src' of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): debited account key.
Parameter 'dst' of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): credited account key.
Parameter 'wad' of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): transferred amount.

edges.reason: receive() executes deposit() so direct ETH transfers are credited through the same code path.
msg.sender is the key credited in balanceOf by deposit().
deposit() writes balanceOf[msg.sender] by adding msg.value.
caller-controlled 'wad' bounds the redemption amount processed by withdraw().
withdraw() subtracts wad from balanceOf[msg.sender] via SafeMath.sub, a balance mutation sensitive to arithmetic correctness.
withdraw() performs the external ETH send, the interaction step of a check-effects-interactions violation.
msg.sender is the address that receives ETH in withdraw(), letting the caller control the external call target and re-enter.
'guy' selects the spender slot written by approve().
'wad' is the approval value stored in allowance[msg.sender][guy].
'dst' of transfer() is forwarded as the destination of transferFrom().
'wad' of transfer() is forwarded as the amount of transferFrom().
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
'src' keys the balanceOf/allowance lookups inside transferFrom().
'dst' is the account credited by transferFrom().
'wad' is the amount debited and credited by transferFrom().
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch in transferFrom() is skipped or enforced.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[src][msg.sender], the spender authorization state.
transferFrom() debits and credits balanceOf with SafeMath sub/add, a balance arithmetic mutation.

normalization_plan.reason: 'wad' is a transient value consumed solely by withdraw() and has no independent semantic identity.
'guy' only selects the allowance slot of approve() and does not need a standalone node.
'wad' is the value written by approve() and is subsumed by that function node.
'dst' is a pass-through argument of transfer() into transferFrom() and carries no separate semantics.
'wad' is a pass-through amount of transfer() into transferFrom().
'src' is only the account key read by transferFrom() and can be folded into the function node.
'dst' is only the credited key of transferFrom() and adds no distinct graph semantics.
'wad' is the transferred amount handled entirely inside transferFrom().
